name: Hasura
summary: Hasura GraphQL Engine is a GraphQL engine for PostgreSQL and other data sources. The vendor documents LTS versioning and EOL on its documentation site; there is no API or structured EOL feed.

evidence.quote: LTS version Status EOL Date v2.11 Retired Sep-01-2024 v2.36 Retired Dec-12-2025 v2.45 Active LTS Dec-2027 v2.50 Upcoming LTS Dec-2028
v2.45 LTS support is extended through December 2027.
v2.36 and older LTS lines are retired and no longer receive security or critical bugfix patches.

notes: The vendor versioning page publishes an LTS table with EOL dates. v2.45 and v2.50 EOL dates are stated in prose as month-precision (December 2027, December 2028) and stored as YYYY-MM without padding to a day, per AGENTS.md rule 4. v2.11 and v2.36 appear in the table with EOL dates in abbreviated month-day-year format (Sep-01-2024, Dec-12-2025) that the evidence verifier does not recognize as a date format; these are confirmed retired by the prose 'v2.36 and older LTS lines are retired and no longer receive security or critical bugfix patches' but the exact EOL dates cannot be backed by recognized evidence. GA dates are not published for any of these versions. Month-precision EOL dates exclude these releases from the day-precision OpenEoX export, where they are enumerated under v1/openeox/index.json exclusions.
